subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the project sponsor this Gateway-owned Claw cron lifecycle as an independently landable experimental primitive, or keep the stacked Claws train paused until the broader lifecycle direction is approved?
rationale: The patch introduces a new durable experimental lifecycle and depends on open stacked work; code review can assess correctness, but only a maintainer can choose the intended landing scope and ordering.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow cron slice
options.body: Restack this PR onto the approved prerequisite, keep only Gateway-owned cron lifecycle behavior, and require live Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the stack paused
options.body: Defer this PR until the broader Claws package, export, and lifecycle product direction has explicit approval.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow cron slice
recommendation.body: Restack this PR onto the approved prerequisite, keep only Gateway-owned cron lifecycle behavior, and require live Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and their prior review established the relevant deletion and durability boundary.
